\nt Let $a_0, a_1, \dots , a_n$ be a sequence of nonnegative numbers. It is unimodal if there is some
$m$, called a mode of the sequence, such that
a_0 \leq a_1 \leq \dots \leq a_{m-1} \leq a_m \geq a_{m+1} \geq \dots \geq a_n.
\nt  We say that a polynomial $\sum^n_{k=0} a_k x^k$ is unimodal,
if the sequence of its coefficients $a_0, a_1, \dots , a_n$ is unimodal (see \cite{Bren,Brenti}).
A mode of the sequence $a_0, a_1, \dots , a_n$ is also called a mode of the polynomial $\sum^n_{k=0} a_k x^k$.
